title: Pecan Chicken Thigh Bites with Mild Honey Glaze
description: Boneless thigh bites keep the honey and pecan smoke of the original wings in a mild, glossy glaze.
equipment: Small enamel Dutch oven with tight lid, sized to hold the food snugly

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made from meat, bones and water, with no added vegetable blend or seasonings.

ingredients.name: hot drinking water
ingredients.note: Keep ready; use only as needed to maintain liquid depth or make up the sauce measure.

steps.title: Heat the Traeger
steps.text: Preheat the Traeger Silverton 610 to 300°F with pecan pellets, about 15 minutes with the lid closed.

steps.title: Warm the braising liquid
steps.text: Bring {broth} with {paprika} and {garlic} just to a simmer in the open Dutch oven on the stove, about 3–6 minutes.

steps.title: Smoke the braising liquid
steps.text: Move the uncovered pot to the Traeger grate. Close the smoker lid and smoke the liquid for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Make even bites
steps.text: Cut {chicken} across the grain into 3/4-inch pieces.

steps.title: Cover the chicken
steps.text: Slip the thigh bites into the smoked broth, adding {topup} as needed to keep them nearly submerged. Fit the lid immediately. Skip a stall wrap.

steps.title: Poach until tender
steps.text: Cook covered at 300°F for 18–35 minutes until several of the largest bites reach 175°F and a fork slips in easily.

steps.title: Rest in the juices
steps.text: Rest the covered chicken off heat for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Reserve the bites
steps.text: Move the chicken to a covered bowl with a little cooking liquid.

steps.title: Measure the sauce base
steps.text: Skim excess fat from the braising liquid. Measure 3/4 cup into the HexClad skillet, topping up with {topup} if needed.

steps.title: Make the honey base
steps.text: Dissolve {honey} and {vinegar} in the measured juices over medium heat.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the skillet liquid to a boil. Whisk in the stirred slurry and simmer for 1 minute, stirring, until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Glaze the bites
steps.text: Turn the chicken in the glaze and spoon the rest into the serving bowls for extra coating.

notes: Make ahead: Cut the thighs and keep chilled until ready to cook. Option A uses a little cider vinegar. For gentler Option B, leave it out. Pass hot honey at the table for extra heat. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze individual portions surrounded by sauce for up to 2 months to protect their moisture. Fridge reheat: Warm one portion covered in its sauce in the HexClad over medium-low heat. Turn gently, adding a splash of water if needed. Check after 6 minutes and continue until the food reaches 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator. Follow the fridge reheating directions and stir the sauce smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 220 kcal, 29.1 g protein, 11.6 g total carbohydrate, 5.9 g fat, 0.3 g fiber, 156 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
